hero.title: Public Health
hero.subtitle: Germany offers globally respected Master of Public Health (MPH) and M.Sc. Epidemiology programmes combining biostatistics, health economics, and global health policy with tuition-free public university options.

overview: Germany provides rigorous academic and research-driven education in Public Health (MPH / M.Sc.) across leading public medical faculties and health sciences universities, with low or zero tuition in most federal states.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide Consultancy guides Indian students through university selection, English and German-taught MPH pathways, APS verification, and student visa processing.
